description: Use this to rename a group, change its icon or currency, or change who can open it by link (visibility: public_editable, public_view_only, or private_registered for members only). A new currency converts existing expenses in the background, so read an expense again before editing it. expectedRevision is the group's lockVersion from get_group, whose viewerAccess says what the user may change.

Visibility.description:
Who can open and edit the group by link. `public_editable` lets anyone
with the link edit, `public_view_only` lets them view, and
`private_registered` limits access to linked members.

currency.description:
New base currency. Existing transactions are rebased onto it in the
background, which bumps their `lockVersion`: re-read a transaction
before updating or deleting it after a currency change. Needs
`viewerAccess.canManageSettings`.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

icon.description: A new emoji for the group's icon.

visibility.description:
Who can open the group by link. Needs `viewerAccess.canManageAccess`.
A restricted group needs a linked admin; the caller becomes one when
the group has none.

name: update_group
title: Edit a group
